question: Two identical coils are placed in the same uniform magnetic field. In the first coil, the normal to the coil makes an angle of $30^\circ$ with the field, and in the second coil, it makes an angle of $60^\circ$ with the field. Compare the magnetic fluxes through the two coils. Justify your answer.

options.A: $\Phi_1:\Phi_2=1:\sqrt{3}$; the second coil has greater flux.
options.B: $\Phi_1:\Phi_2=\sqrt{3}:1$; the first coil has greater flux because its normal makes the smaller angle with the field.
options.C: $\Phi_1:\Phi_2=1:1$; both coils have the same flux.
options.D: $\Phi_1:\Phi_2=2:1$; the first coil has twice the flux.
